using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Embeddings;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.OpenAI;
using OpenAI;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Test.Extensions;

public class OpenAIServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration_WithClient_NullClient_CallsGetServiceForLoggerFactory()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton(mockLoggerFactory);

        // Act
        services.AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration("text-embedding-ada-002", (OpenAIClient?)null);

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var embeddingService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(embeddingService);
        Assert.Same(mockLoggerFactory, ((dynamic)embeddingService!).LoggerFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration_WithClient_ProvidedClient_IgnoresServiceProviderClient()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        var testClient = new OpenAIClient();
        services.AddSingleton(mockLoggerFactory);

        // Act
        services.AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration("text-embedding-ada-002", testClient);

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var embeddingService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(embeddingService);
        Assert.Same(mockLoggerFactory, ((dynamic)embeddingService!).LoggerFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration_WithClient_NoLoggerFactory_ReturnsNullLoggerFactory()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act
        services.AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration("text-embedding-ada-002", (OpenAIClient?)null);

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var embeddingService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(embeddingService);
        var loggerFactory = ((dynamic)embeddingService!).LoggerFactory;
        Assert.Null(loggerFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration_ApiKeyVersion_CallsGetServiceForLoggerFactory()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton(mockLoggerFactory);

        // Act
        services.AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration("text-embedding-ada-002", "fake-api-key");

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var embeddingService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(embeddingService);
        Assert.Same(mockLoggerFactory, ((dynamic)embeddingService!).LoggerFactory);
    }
}

public class MockLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
{
    public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider) { }
    public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => NullLogger.Instance;
    public void Dispose() { }
}
